eligible: supported error gold with a structured location and a unique verbatim gold quote in its source field
hit: successful public-process error prediction, matching first layer and source_field/step_id/entry_index, whose bound quote contains the full gold quote verbatim
missing_failed_abstained: remain in eligible denominator; not hits
limitations: Mechanical citation coverage, not semantic correctness, precise first-error localization, or a replacement for exact match
Longer quotes can increase coverage; report quote lengths and retain original exact-match scores
Code and step locations are different sources; no inference from affected_steps or explanations
Constructed probes remain separate from development and held-out statistics
